page.content:
WWE's Monday flagship since 1993.

How Monday Night Raw connects

  • Topic: WWE — Monday Night Raw is WWE's longest-running weekly flagship.
  • Event: Monday Night Wars — The Monday Night Wars were fought on Raw against WCW Nitro.
  • Character: John Cena — John Cena was the long-running face of Monday Night Raw.

What is Monday Night Raw?

Monday Night Raw is the weekly show that became the Attitude Era battleground with Nitro, then the long-running red brand that still carries world-title segments.

Key threads lead to WWE, Monday Night Wars and John Cena.
